propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit ticket by blaming the pre-fix parent commit and resolving its rebar-ticket: trailer, only when a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines point to a single commit.

The auto-derivation must reuse existing extract_ticket_refs() to parse rebar-ticket: trailers and match against the bug ID, skipping derivation if no fixing commit is found or no dominant culprit resolves.
The caused_by auto-link must bypass the closed-source guard by writing directly via _write_link_event after the bug transitions to closed, so the edge is committed despite the source status guard.
A --caused-by <id> explicit override parameter must thread through transition_compute and close_ticket to set caused_by at close time, taking precedence over auto-derivation.
The public library facade transition() must accept and thread a caused_by parameter end-to-end so library callers (not just CLI) can set caused_by on close.
Ambiguous multi-commit blame (no >50% dominant commit) or missing file_impact must yield no auto-link; failure to resolve caused_by never blocks the close.
